confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one web search of aggregated cost-of-living sites (Nomad Watch, Citycost, Expat Arrivals). Their figures vary by source. Cocktail and wine are not sourced. I estimated them from the local beer price, at roughly 1.7x beer for a cocktail and 1.4x for a wine glass. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates, not checked against any listings. The July 2026 pricing window is not the date of the data. The FX rate is the latest RBA observation, from 18 November 2026, found via one RBA search. It is not the rate for the July 2026 reference window.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other northern Chilean and southern Peruvian cities such as Iquique, Tacna and Arequipa. Arica is a modest beach and border city with limited tourism demand.
